_comment:
json — the 9th std pkg (the rut-json batch, phase 1). The base owns
every public name (traits, reader/writer classes, entries, errors);
the optional peers carry the impl-only integration groups — the
container rows of the survey's §2.6 matrix. Presence-based mounting:
a consumer whose closure holds `pouch` gets the Vec rows, one that
holds `nmapset` the map/set rows; the dev-deps guarantee both while
json builds itself (the peer gate's D3 path checks run on this very
manifest), so every group impl dispatches in json's own test runs.
Landed as the mechanism's first real consumer.

Publishes COMPILED (the linkable-classes phase): the entries are
GENERIC FUNCTIONS, and instantiation is owner-anchored — a consumer
requests `decodeJson<i64>` from this pkg, whose unit compiles the
monomorphized body (the surface exports names + signatures; the
ledger carries the instantiations). The peer groups compile INTO
json's unit wherever json is packed (the dev-deps supply presence at
pack time — compile once per owner), so the container rows travel
inside json's binary and the `lib` keys stay the presence/D2
contract.
